cd /var/lib/pgsql/data && sudo -u postgres tee -a postgresql.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'

# --- replication + TLS config ---
listen_addresses = '*'
wal_level = replica
max_wal_senders = 10
max_replication_slots = 10
hot_standby = on
ssl = on
ssl_cert_file = 'server.crt'
ssl_key_file = 'server.key'
ssl_ca_file = 'server-ca.crt'
